changelog: # rcc change log ## Unreleased ## v18.19.11 - pin embedded micromamba to 2.10.0 (upstream build 2.10.0-0), validate archive and executable hashes, and regenerate stale compressed assets. Add native version, extraction and environment acceptance checks; release qualification still requires all four supported native targets (GH#279) - add a behavioral regression proving that dry-run garbage collection preserves eligible ready environments; production behavior is unchanged (GH#281, PR#282) ## v18.19.10 (date: 08.11.2026) ### Operator revocation lifecycle - add public commands to issue, renew, revoke and distribute authenticated v2 metadata snapshots without rebuilding or republishing the Artifact. Support independent metadata authority, complete deny sets, sequence checkpoints, delivery receipts, authorized key rotation and recovery (GH#254, PR#270) - admit new strict leases after valid renewal for the same Artifact digest. Revoked snapshots deny new leases while an already-running child retains its original decision. Preserve retained anti-rollback state across renewal, rotation and recovery. Deployments still require independent roots and an initial sequence floor, trusted time and retained state. Offline workers cannot know globally latest unseen state. Host compromise, trusted-disk rollback and power-loss durability remain outside these guarantees (PR#270) ### Signed offline archives - let public `env export` explicitly select a trust carrier and include detached evidence with `--include-trust-attachments`. Let `env acquire` consume that evidence with `--consume-archive-trust` and return the selected carrier path for strict execution on an independent offline worker (GH#255, PR#275) - bind consumed evidence to a bounded snapshot of the selected archive bytes, so a warm home cannot borrow metadata omitted from another archive. Retain path and size checks, require a matching expected `--artifact` when supplied, and keep deployment roots and sequence state independent of archive contents. Archive keys are not automatically trusted, and import does not enable a permissive fallback (PR#275) ### Truthful object inventory - identify generated records as RCC object inventory with `application/vnd.rcc.environment.inventory.v1+json`, not SPDX or an installed package SBOM. Prefer `env publish --inventory` while retaining historical aliases. Leave unknown software versions empty and keep complete object hashes, allowing JAT-sized inventories within the unchanged v2 evidence limits without dropping entries (GH#257, PR#271) - preserve authenticated legacy inventory bytes without relabeling them. Released v18.19.9 verifiers reject the new media type. Upgrade verifiers first or explicitly supply canonical legacy inventory. Recovery after a later policy denial can require a higher sequence in the same journal, never a state reset. Genuine schema-validated package SBOM work remains separate GH#272. Object inventory and package observations do not establish package CVE or license coverage (PR#271) ### Prewarm coordination - retry transient lock contention and avoid starving publication while a live build claim exists. Keep verified Artifact readiness, claim ownership, cancellation and non-waiting behavior intact (GH#273, PR#274)
